sloka: सन्दिश्य रामं नृपतिः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने ।पुरोहितं समाहूय वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-५-१॥
transliteration: sandiśya rāmaṁ nṛpatiḥ śvobhāvinyabhiṣecane ।purohitaṁ samāhūya vasiṣṭhamidamabravīt ॥2-5-1॥

translations.english: The king having instructed Rama summoned Vasistha, the priest and spoke to him about the coronation that was to take place on the following day
